exposure: ST waveform analysis of the fetal electrocardiogram
cohort: Medium- and high-risk singleton pregnancies with fetuses in cephalic presentation, gestational age of ≥36 weeks, and intention to deliver vaginally
finding: The implementation of ST waveform analysis of the fetal electrocardiogram was associated with an 84% decrease in the incidence of umbilical artery metabolic acidosis, as well as reductions in fetal blood sampling, cesarean sections, instrumental vaginal deliveries, and neonatal encephalopathy.
mod_finding: Overall cesarean and vaginal instrumental deliveries decreased significantly, but not specifically for fetal distress.
